title: Hunyuan-A13B Technical Report
paper_type_zh: 前沿模型技术报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 需要审计大规模 STEM 数据、GRPO、sandbox/GRM 反馈及后训练可复现性边界的读者
one_line: A frontier-model disclosure describing a >20T-token foundation corpus, a 250B-token STEM subset, four post-training stages, a 150K-problem reasoning-RL mixture, a five-role agent synthesis engine, and a multi-service reward stack, while leaving record-level data and rollout artefacts unreleased.
Hunyuan-A13B 报告了 20T 级数据、250B STEM 数据、四个 SFT/RL 阶段、GRPO 及 sandbox/GRM 反馈；但来源清单、教师模型、奖励权重和审计工件仍未披露或未核验。
why: For the frontier-reports data-disclosure track, Hunyuan-A13B provides unusually concrete stage-level counts and verifier/environment descriptions that can be separated into auditable claims. It is still a model report rather than a released dataset: exact records, provenance, splits, licences, verifier implementations, and RL trajectories remain unavailable.
inclusion_reason: A frontier technical report that discloses large-scale STEM data, four SFT/RL stages, GRPO, and sandbox/GRM feedback while leaving underlying data lineage and feedback implementation incompletely auditable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
This card treats Hunyuan-A13B as a data-disclosure record, not as evidence that a benchmark-leading model necessarily used high-quality data. The technical report describes an 80B-total, 13B-active MoE model trained on more than 20T foundation-corpus tokens, including a 250B-token STEM subset, followed by four post-training stages: reasoning SFT, reasoning RL, all-scenarios SFT, and all-scenarios RL. The audit question is therefore: what training objects, source classes, construction steps, verifiers, rewards, and environments can be recovered from the report, and what remains unavailable?

The report gives useful aggregate counts and mechanisms but no record-level corpus. Exact prompt manifests, most mixture sizes, source URLs and licences, verifier checkpoints, rollout counts, reward logs, and replayable agent environments are unknown. Model weights and code availability must be kept separate from training-data availability.

本卡把 Hunyuan-A13B 视为一条数据披露记录，而不是把模型在基准上的领先表现等同于高质量训练数据的证据。技术报告描述了一个总参数 80B、激活参数 13B 的 MoE 模型：基础语料超过 20T token，其中包括 250B token 的 STEM 子集，随后依次进行推理 SFT、推理 RL、全场景 SFT 和全场景 RL。审计的核心问题是：报告究竟披露了哪些训练对象、来源类型、构造步骤、验证器、奖励与环境，又有哪些关键事实仍不可得？

报告提供了有价值的汇总规模和机制说明，但没有公开记录级语料。精确 prompt 清单、大多数混合比例、来源 URL 与许可、验证器 checkpoint、rollout 数量、奖励日志和可重放的 agent 环境仍为 unknown。模型权重和代码的公开不能与训练数据公开混为一谈。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The disclosure is best read as four linked but distinct data contracts.

  1. Reasoning SFT. Mathematics is drawn from educational materials and checked with a generative reward model plus automated solution verification. Code originates from open-source resources and passes a construction pipeline with critics and sandbox execution. Logic combines copyrighted and public puzzle collections with synthetic problems, automated chain-of-thought assessment, and human review. Science is filtered for difficulty and quality, verified by an advanced LLM, and selected through rejection sampling.
  2. Reasoning RL. A 150,000-problem pool mixes mathematics, coding, logic, and science at 2:2:1:1. Ten percent overlaps SFT and 90% is described as novel. GRPO receives binary-style outcome signals from normalized answer/reference matching or code sandbox tests.
  3. All-scenarios SFT. The mixture expands to language, writing, multilingual, instruction-following, role-play, knowledge QA, multi-turn, and agent tasks. Agent traces are synthesized by user, planner, tool, agent, and checker roles over real sandbox tools, MCP servers, and synthetic tools.
  4. All-scenarios RL. A general reward model and more than 30 scoring services cover 16 subtopics; agent scoring combines format and reference-based tool-call correctness.

The resulting model supports /think and /no_think modes, with reasoning represented in a special think block. The report does not disclose the internal serialized record schema.

这份披露应拆成四个相互衔接、但不能混写的数据契约。

  1. 推理 SFT。 数学数据来自教育材料，并由生成式奖励模型与自动解题验证共同筛选；代码来自开源资源，经过构造流水线、critic 与 sandbox 执行；逻辑数据混合版权受限和公开的谜题集以及合成题目，再通过自动思维链评价和人工审查；科学数据先做难度与质量筛选，再由高级 LLM 验证并通过拒绝采样保留。
  2. 推理 RL。 150,000 道题按数学、代码、逻辑、科学 2:2:1:1 混合，其中 10% 与 SFT 重叠，90% 被报告为新题。GRPO 的结果奖励来自归一化后的答案—参考答案匹配，或代码 sandbox 测试。
  3. 全场景 SFT。 数据扩展到语言、写作、多语、指令遵循、角色扮演、知识问答、多轮对话和 agent。Agent 轨迹由 user、planner、tool、agent、checker 五类角色合成，工具来自真实 sandbox、MCP server 与合成工具。
  4. 全场景 RL。 一个通用奖励模型和 30 多个评分服务覆盖 16 个子主题；agent 评分把格式检查与基于参考的工具调用正确性结合起来。

最终模型支持 /think 与 /no_think 两种模式，并用特殊 think block 承载推理。报告没有披露内部记录的序列化 schema。

title: Method
方法
html:
Foundation and context preparation. The report reuses the Hunyuan-TurboS-family pretraining pipeline: preprocessing, deduplication, low-quality filtering, denoising, topic labels, model-assisted extraction, and postprocessing with semantic deduplication. It reports more than 20T foundation tokens, a strengthened 250B STEM subset, a 300B-token fast-annealing phase, and context extension first to 32K and then 256K. These are aggregate corpus/process claims; record manifests are absent.

Domain-specific SFT controls. Each reasoning domain has a different feedback path rather than one universal judge. Mathematics combines a generative reward model with automated solution verification. Code uses critics and a sandbox. Logic uses automated chain-of-thought evaluation plus human review. Science uses an advanced LLM verifier and rejection sampling. The generator models, thresholds, acceptance rates, and reviewer protocol are not given.

On-policy reasoning RL. GRPO trains on 150K problems with a 2:2:1:1 domain ratio. Multiple-choice, true/false, and proof tasks are excluded. The curriculum moves from 24K to 32K context. The report states that training is on-policy, uses large batches, increases the number of sampled rollouts, omits a KL penalty, and samples at temperature 0.6-0.8. Exact rollout multiplicity, batch size, learning rate, and step count are unknown.

All-scenarios agent construction and feedback. The synthesis engine separates user, planner, tool, agent, and checker roles. It uses sandbox tools, MCP servers, and synthetic tools, covers more than 30 types of agent system instruction, and creates 20,000 tool/action/response format combinations, with emphasis on tasks such as Excel and deep search. All-scenarios RL uses candidate/reference comparison, optional chain-of-thought, tool calls, and length/constraint checks; more than 30 services score 16 subtopics. Agent reward checks special-marker order and tool names, parameters, and values against references. Environment snapshots and scoring weights are not released.

基础语料与上下文准备。 报告沿用 Hunyuan-TurboS 系列的预训练流水线，包括预处理、去重、低质过滤、去噪、主题标注、模型辅助抽取，以及带语义去重的后处理。报告给出的汇总量包括：超过 20T 的基础 token、强化后的 250B STEM 子集、300B token 的快速退火阶段，以及先扩展到 32K、再到 256K 的上下文训练。这些都是语料与流程的汇总披露，没有记录清单。

分领域 SFT 质量控制。 各推理领域使用不同的反馈链，而不是统一 judge。数学结合生成式奖励模型和自动解题验证；代码使用 critic 与 sandbox；逻辑采用自动思维链评价和人工审查；科学使用高级 LLM 验证器与拒绝采样。报告未给出生成模型、阈值、接受率和人工审查协议。

On-policy 推理 RL。 GRPO 在 150K 道题上训练，领域比例为 2:2:1:1，并排除选择题、判断题和证明题。课程从 24K 上下文推进到 32K。报告明确说明训练为 on-policy、使用大 batch、增加 rollout 采样数量、不使用 KL penalty，采样温度为 0.6–0.8；但 rollout 倍数、batch size、learning rate 和训练步数均为 unknown。

全场景 agent 构造与反馈。 合成引擎把 user、planner、tool、agent、checker 分成五个角色，调用 sandbox 工具、MCP server 和合成工具，覆盖 30 多类 agent system instruction，并创建 20,000 种 tool/action/response 格式组合，重点包括 Excel 与 deep search 等任务。全场景 RL 可进行 candidate/reference 比较，也可读取思维链、调用工具并检查长度或约束；30 多个服务覆盖 16 个子主题。Agent 奖励既检查特殊标记及顺序，也按参考答案核对工具名、参数和值。环境快照和评分权重没有公开。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence is structural rather than record-level. The official technical report states the model scale, >20T foundation corpus, 250B STEM subset, 300B annealing stage, 150K reasoning-RL pool, 2:2:1:1 domain ratio, 10%/90% overlap statement, 24K-to-32K RL schedule, 0.6-0.8 sampling temperature, 36-language code sandbox, five-role agent engine, 20,000 format combinations, 16 RL subtopics, and more than 30 scoring services. These details support a stage-level recipe reconstruction.

The official GitHub repository and Hugging Face organization support the claim that model weights and inference/training-related code artefacts are available. They do not establish that the SFT records, on-policy rollouts, rejected samples, tool traces, reward logs, or complete source manifests were released.

Reported benchmark tables are evidence about the trained model under the authors' evaluation protocol. They are not direct evidence that individual training examples are correct, licensed, uncontaminated, diverse, or reproducible. No card claim should cross that boundary.

最强的证据来自流程结构，而不是记录级数据。官方技术报告明确给出了模型规模、超过 20T 的基础语料、250B STEM 子集、300B 退火阶段、150K 推理 RL 题池、2:2:1:1 领域比例、10%/90% 重叠说明、24K 到 32K 的 RL 课程、0.6–0.8 采样温度、支持 36 种编程语言的代码 sandbox、五角色 agent 引擎、20,000 种格式组合、16 个 RL 子主题和 30 多个评分服务。这些事实足以重建阶段级 recipe。

官方 GitHub 仓库和 Hugging Face 组织可支持“模型权重及训练/推理相关代码 artefact 可获得”这一判断，但不能据此声称 SFT 记录、on-policy rollout、被拒样本、工具轨迹、奖励日志或完整来源清单已经公开。

报告中的 benchmark 表格只反映训练后模型在作者评测协议下的表现，不能直接证明单条训练样本正确、许可清晰、无污染、具有多样性或可复现。本卡不会越过这条证据边界。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The useful contribution for a data atlas is the report's decomposition of one frontier post-training program into domain-specific construction and verification contracts. The five-role agent generator and its 20,000 tool/action/response format combinations expose more of the agent-data construction scaffold than a generic statement that synthetic trajectories were used. The separation between reasoning outcome reward and all-scenarios multi-service reward also makes the feedback stack auditable at a coarse level.

None of these components should be described as wholly novel without a comparative literature analysis: GRPO, rejection sampling, code sandboxes, LLM judges, synthetic agent roles, and reference-based tool-call checking predate this report. The distinctive value here is the combination and the unusually concrete aggregate disclosure, not a new released corpus or a complete reproducible pipeline.

对数据图谱而言，这份报告的主要价值是把一个前沿模型的后训练工程拆解成多个分领域构造与验证契约。五角色 agent 生成器及其 20,000 种 tool/action/response 格式组合，比“使用了合成轨迹”这样的笼统表述披露了更多 agent 数据构造骨架。推理结果奖励与全场景多服务奖励的分离，也让反馈栈至少可以在粗粒度上被审计。

若没有系统的相关工作比较，不应把这些组件写成完全新颖：GRPO、拒绝采样、代码 sandbox、LLM judge、合成 agent 角色和基于参考的工具调用核验都早于该报告。这里更有辨识度的是它们的组合方式与较具体的汇总披露，而不是一个新公开的语料库或完整可复现流水线。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Exact source datasets, URLs, item manifests, licences, and record-level provenance are not disclosed; logic SFT explicitly mentions copyrighted puzzle collections.
  • Counts for reasoning SFT, all-scenarios SFT, and all-scenarios RL are unknown. The 150K figure is a problem-pool size, not a disclosed rollout count.
  • The 10% SFT overlap / 90% novel statement lacks manifests or hashes, so it cannot be independently checked.
  • Verifier checkpoints, prompts, thresholds, calibration data, acceptance rates, and false-positive analyses are absent.
  • GRPO omits exact batch size, learning rate, steps, rollout multiplicity, retained/rejected trajectory counts, and reward logs.
  • Sandbox images, tool/MCP versions, reference generation, retries, timeouts, and termination conditions are not released, limiting agent replay.
  • Generic semantic deduplication is reported, but benchmark-specific decontamination and overlap counts are not.
  • Weights and code are available; no complete training-data or trajectory release with an explicit licence was verified.
  • Benchmark performance is not a substitute for auditing data quality, legality, contamination, or verifier bias.

• 精确来源数据集、URL、样本清单、许可和记录级 provenance 均未披露；逻辑 SFT 还明确包含版权受限的谜题集。
  • 推理 SFT、全场景 SFT 与全场景 RL 的数量未知。150K 指题目池规模，不是已披露的 rollout 数量。
  • “10% 与 SFT 重叠、90% 为新题”没有对应清单或 hash，无法独立复核。
  • 验证器 checkpoint、prompt、阈值、校准数据、接受率与假阳性分析缺失。
  • GRPO 未给出精确 batch size、learning rate、训练步数、rollout 倍数、保留/拒绝轨迹数量和奖励日志。
  • Sandbox 镜像、工具/MCP 版本、参考答案生成方式、重试、timeout 与终止条件未公开，agent 过程难以重放。
  • 报告提到通用语义去重，但没有 benchmark 专项的去污染规则和重叠计数。
  • 权重与代码可获得；尚未核实存在带明确许可的完整训练数据或轨迹发布。
  • Benchmark 表现不能替代对数据质量、合法性、污染和验证器偏差的审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Frontier Reports & Data-Disclosure Ledger track, this report can support several bounded uses.

  • Record stage-level disclosure rows for foundation pretraining, reasoning SFT, reasoning RL, all-scenarios SFT, and all-scenarios RL without collapsing them into one undifferentiated dataset.
  • Compare frontier reports on which quantities they disclose: source classes, pool sizes, overlap statements, context schedules, environment capacity, verifier families, and reward-service counts.
  • Reuse the five-role agent scaffold and domain-specific verifier taxonomy as design hypotheses for a new pipeline, provided implementers independently specify sources, licences, schemas, tools, termination, and QA.
  • Build an audit checklist for outcome-reward systems: normalization rules, sandbox coverage, service calibration, rollout retention, and reward-model identity.
  • Track the release boundary explicitly: official model/code artefacts exist, while data records and rollout logs remain unavailable.

The report should not be used as a downloadable dataset record, a reproducible-data claim, or proof that benchmark improvements establish data quality.

在 Frontier Reports & Data-Disclosure Ledger 轨道中，这份报告适合以下边界明确的用途。

  • 分别记录基础预训练、推理 SFT、推理 RL、全场景 SFT 和全场景 RL 的阶段级披露，而不是把它们压成一个无差别“数据集”。
  • 比较不同前沿报告披露了哪些量：来源类型、题池规模、重叠说明、上下文课程、环境容量、验证器家族和奖励服务数量。
  • 把五角色 agent scaffold 与分领域验证器分类当作新流水线的设计假设；真正实现时仍需独立说明来源、许可、schema、工具、终止条件和 QA。
  • 为结果奖励系统建立审计清单，包括答案归一化、sandbox 覆盖、服务校准、rollout 保留策略和 reward model 身份。
  • 明确记录发布边界：官方模型与代码 artefact 存在，但数据记录和 rollout 日志不可得。

不应把该报告登记成可下载数据集，也不能据此声称数据可复现，更不能把 benchmark 提升当成数据质量证明。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Report identity and model scale: 26 June 2025; corporate author Tencent Hunyuan Team; 80B total and 13B active parameters.
  • Pretraining disclosures: more than 20T foundation tokens, a 250B STEM subset, 300B fast annealing, and context extension to 32K then 256K.
  • Reasoning-RL disclosures: 150K problems in a 2:2:1:1 math/code/logic/science mixture, 10% SFT overlap, 90% novel, 24K then 32K, GRPO without KL, and temperature 0.6-0.8.
  • Agent/environment disclosures: five synthesis roles, real/synthetic/MCP tools, more than 30 instruction types, 20,000 format combinations, and a 36-language sandbox with more than 1,000 concurrent instances.
  • Reward disclosures: 16 all-scenario RL subtopics and more than 30 scoring services.
  • Exact internal schemas, three stage-level data counts, source licenses, verifier implementations, and rollout artifacts are unknown; model/code release does not imply training-data release.

• 报告与模型规模：2025 年 6 月 26 日；团体作者为 Tencent Hunyuan Team；总参数 80B、激活参数 13B。
  • 预训练披露：基础 token 超过 20T、250B STEM 子集、300B 快速退火，以及上下文先扩展到 32K 再到 256K。
  • 推理 RL 披露：150K 道题按数学/代码/逻辑/科学 2:2:1:1 混合，10% 与 SFT 重叠、90% 为新题，24K 后转 32K，GRPO 不使用 KL，温度为 0.6–0.8。
  • Agent/环境披露：五个合成角色，真实/合成/MCP 工具，30 多类 instruction，20,000 种格式组合，以及支持 36 种语言、1,000 多并发实例的 sandbox。
  • 奖励披露：全场景 RL 有 16 个子主题和 30 多个评分服务。
  • 精确内部 schema、三个阶段的数据量、来源许可、验证器实现和 rollout artefact 均为 unknown；模型/代码发布不等于训练数据发布。
